intro: The Tower of Eldara is an ancient, sealed night elven spire situated on the far northeastern promontory overlooking the Bay of Storms in Azshara. Though long abandoned, its sturdy stone architecture has survived the Sundering, standing silent above coasts roamed by aggressive coastal beasts.

p: Perched on a remote cliff edge northeast of the Bay of Storms, the Tower of Eldara stands as a lonely testament to the vast kaldorei empire that once dominated this coastline. Like much of Azshara's ruined architecture, it fell into disuse following the Great Sundering thousands of years ago. Today, the entrance remains firmly closed and barred against the outside world, giving no hint of whatever relics or chambers lie sealed inside. The surrounding shores are fraught with danger, prowled constantly by wandering murlocs, clawing makrura, and predatory hydras that keep all but the most daring travelers away.
